summary: Full 2-context live P2P trade E2E validated end-to-end. Lobby renders with market-filter-live, invite/accept round-trip works via WebSocket, both users land in trade-room with 4-column layout, item add/remove sync live to peer, amber input caps at balance/day limit (500), anti-scam alert triggers correctly with lock reset, both-lock + both-confirm completes swap, completion toast appears, both return to lobby, and Historial shows the trade for both users (with 'Diste'/'Recibiste').

test_results.fresh_lobby_renders: PASS - live-trade-hub visible on both users after clicking market-filter-live
test_results.invite_flow: PASS - A clicked invite-btn-<B_id>, B saw trade-invite-popup, accepted, both landed in trade-room
test_results.four_column_layout: PASS - my-inventory-grid, my-offer-slots, their-offer-slots, their-inventory-grid all visible
test_results.item_add_remove: PASS - clicking inv-item-<id> creates my-offered-<id>; clicking it removes it
test_results.live_peer_sync: PASS - both directions: A sees B's their-offered-<id>, and vice versa in real time
test_results.anti_scam_alert: PASS - after A locked, B modified offer -> trade-scam-alert visible on A and A's lock button reverted from 'Desbloquear' to 'Bloquear'
test_results.complete_swap: PASS - both locked -> both confirmed -> toast '¡Intercambio completado!' shown, both returned to live-trade-hub lobby
test_results.historial: PASS - trade-history renders 7 rows for both users (includes prior + this new trade)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: On B page there were sporadic 503 responses in console logs during load (some background resource); not blocking. Main agent may want to check which endpoint returns 503 on second context.
TradeRoom.jsx Avatar for 'Tú' passes src=undefined (line 107) - no avatar shown for self; cosmetic only.
LiveTradeHub.jsx cancelOutgoing calls tradeActive() then tradeCancel; if user cancels quickly before session exists this silently no-ops - acceptable.
Framer-motion popup uses z-[120] which overlaps other modals - fine here but ensure only one modal-portal registered.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded Users A and B (Demo Survivor / Demo Trader) per credentials in review request; state was pre-reset by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The full 2-context live trade flow is working. Test used browser.new_context to spawn parallel A/B pages, both authenticated via localStorage primal_token, both navigated to /marketplace and clicked market-filter-live, WS presence populated within ~2s. If retesting, be aware history rows accumulate (already 7 rows) since state was not re-cleared before this run. To reset: python3 /app/backend/_seed_trade_test.py && python3 /app/backend/_reset_trade_test.py. Screenshot API png does not support 'quality' param - use jpg or omit quality.
